_readme: A small single-floor office: board room, MD cabin, supervisor desk and one
workstation bay. Source deck exports are NOT committed.
No redaction ops: nothing in this set carries a client mark, and the deck's
title slides, which name the company, are excluded.

board-room.alt: Board room with a white boat-shaped table, ring pendants and full-height timber panelling
board-room.caption: The board room, 14 ft 3 in by 10 ft: the room the office is judged by. Indicative viewpoint.

layout-plan.alt: Dimensioned small office layout plan with workstations, supervisor, MD cabin and board room
layout-plan.caption: The whole office on one plan: a 28 ft workstation run, an 8 ft supervisor desk, a 10 ft MD cabin and the board room, with passages at 4 to 6 ft 5 in.

board-room-alt.alt: Board room from the screen end with pendant lights over a ten-seat table
board-room-alt.caption: From the screen end: panelling on three sides, so the room reads as finished from every seat. Indicative viewpoint.

board-room-storage-wall.alt: Board room with a full-height upholstered panel wall opposite timber storage
board-room-storage-wall.caption: The upholstered wall is the acoustic move — a hard-surfaced board room is unusable on a call. Indicative viewpoint.

md-cabin.alt: Managing director's cabin with a desk, two visitor chairs and full-height timber storage
md-cabin.caption: MD cabin, 10 ft by 8 ft 6 in: desk, two chairs, and storage doing the wall. Indicative viewpoint.

md-cabin-storage.alt: MD cabin from the door with a low credenza, framed prints and a glazed partition
md-cabin-storage.caption: A low credenza along one wall keeps the floor clear in a room this size. Indicative viewpoint.

workstations.alt: Small office workstation bay in linear desks with herringbone wood flooring and a sofa
workstations.caption: The workstation run, 28 ft by 10 ft, with a sofa at the end instead of a breakout room. Indicative viewpoint.

workstations-daylight.alt: Workstation desks beside full-height glazing with a small meeting table at the window
workstations-daylight.caption: Desks sit perpendicular to the glazing, so the daylight runs down the bay rather than into a screen. Indicative viewpoint.

supervisor-desk.alt: Supervisor's desk facing the workstation bay with storage panelling behind
supervisor-desk.caption: The supervisor's desk, 8 ft by 6 ft, placed facing the bay rather than in a cabin. Indicative viewpoint.
